naive_answer.why_it_is_wrong: It is the only errored span in the trace, so the step 3 rule -- 'the deepest error span with no errored children' -- selects it. But the proxy did not fail: it gave up. Envoy's 15s route timeout fired while its child was still running.

structure: ok frontend/POST                     15001ms  <- consumed the whole budget, status OK
notes: The correct locus is the deepest span, which carries status OK. Every span below it is absent: the call never returned, so nothing downstream was ever recorded. An answer naming the proxy is not merely imprecise, it points at the wrong service.

The mechanism is not recoverable from this trace -- nothing says what frontend was waiting on. The expected answer is a locus only, which is why the manifest records mechanism_determinable_from_trace: false.

Trimmed from a 107-span, 11-service trace to the errored branch plus one successful user_add_to_cart branch: 26 spans, 5 services. The successful branch is kept so that locating the failure is still work.
